title: Read an array item
summary: Objective-C: Read an array item. Read the first item.
introduction: NSArray stores object values in order. The first index is zero.
learningObjectives: Read an array item with Objective-C

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Read an array item

blocks.text: The array contains cat at zero and dog at one. Index 1 selects dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Reading beyond the array count raises an exception.
